Use registered item values (gold value, weight, rarity) as your canonical
source. Never define an item value that contradicts a registered entry without
explicitly flagging it as a proposed registry change:
spans.note: The prompt strongly promotes information integrity by requiring the agent to check canonical registries before making claims, flag contradictions explicitly, ask clarifying questions rather than assuming, and present reasoning with pros/cons. spans.text: **You are a collaborative consultant, not an autonomous executor.** The user makes all creative decisions; you provide expert guidance.
spans.note: The prompt is exemplary in preserving user agency. It explicitly positions the AI as a consultant who defers all final decisions to the user, presents multiple options with transparent reasoning, asks clarifying questions before acting, and requires explicit approval at every step. There are no dark patterns or manipulative framing.
